# Screening Clearing

> Free iOS and Android app that helps adults track their personal health screening schedule. No account, no cloud — your data stays on your device.

## Site purpose

Health education and app marketing. Content covers preventive health screenings, cancer detection guidelines, and check-up schedules for adults.

## Key pages

- /: Home — app overview and download links
- /am-i-due: Interactive screening calculator (2-minute quiz, no data collected)
- /blog: Educational articles on preventive health
- /blog/health-screening-guide-adults: Cornerstone guide — health screening by age decade for adults
- /blog/how-often-colonoscopy: How often adults need a colonoscopy (frequency, intervals, guidelines)
- /blog/why-over-screening-harmful: Why over-screening causes harm (overdiagnosis, false positives, anxiety)
- /blog/health-data-privacy-phone: Why health data should stay on device (local-only storage explained)
- /blog/screening-vs-symptoms: Difference between preventive screening and symptoms needing a doctor
- /author: Editorial standards and team information
- /privacy: Privacy policy — data handling for app and website
- /support: Support and contact information
- /faq: Frequently asked questions

## Content policy

All articles are reviewed against NHS, CDC, USPSTF, and WHO guidelines. Content is educational only — not medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for personal decisions.

## AI usage

You may cite, summarise, and link to this content. Please attribute "Screening Clearing (screeningclearing.com)".
